The '''Eidoloni sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> just [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] west of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="Mid Rim map">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref>
